label: THE SECOND KEY · SERIAL

slides.text: Previously: behind a plastered wall, a hidden twelfth room. Twelve years of rejection letters to a writer called "Sitara."
Under the desk, a tin trunk with a brass lock. Ananya held up ammamma's key. It turned like it had been waiting forty years.
No saris. No gold. Four hundred handwritten pages, tied with a sari border. On top, a title: The Second Key. 1984.
Ananya knew that handwriting. Grocery lists, birthday cards, every letter to Bangalore. Sitara was ammamma.
Page one said: "Read the last chapter first." It was called "Lakshmi." Her mother's name.

caption:
The key finally fits. And the novel inside has a name Ananya knows too well. 🗝️
